info.title: FinCopy API
info.description: Your hosted MT4 and MT5 accounts: read balance, equity and positions, and place or close trades. Authenticate with a personal API key in the X-Api-Key header or with your signed-in member session; create keys in the member area under API, or have FinCopy issue one. First-party browser clients send the signed-in fincopy_member session cookie; keep API keys on trusted servers. A key reaches its member's own accounts and the accounts shared with that member (shared for trading: tradable; shared for viewing: read-only). Trades are asynchronous: a successful reply means the order is queued for your terminal, which picks it up within seconds; follow the change feed (or a webhook) to see it filled or rejected. Each key uses its configured requests-per-minute limit (default 60).

get.summary: List the accounts this key can reach, each with its terminal, broker server and latest state.

post.summary:
Add a hosted account for the key's owner. It waits for approval and a hosted instance, as on the member screens.
            Send an Idempotency-Key: a retry with the same key returns the account the first call made. ExternalRef is your own id
            for the account. Needs the Trade permission.

get.summary: Places available for a demo terminal on the selected platform.
One account: terminal status, balance, equity, margin, open positions, pending orders and recent orders.

delete.summary:
Remove the account and its hosted terminal. Only the account's owner can. The Idempotency-Key header is
            required: a retry while the removal runs returns the same operation; after it finishes the account answers 404.
            Needs the Trade permission. Returns the operation id.

put.summary:
Set your own id for the account (for example your portfolio number); an empty value clears it. Works before the
            account is added. It comes back on the account and on every change-feed row. Needs the Trade permission.

get.summary:
The account's trading record: its settings (ACCSTG, the symbol template SYMSTG), mode and money. Exists from the
            account is added; until its first sync, live account data is empty.

patch.summary:
Change the account's settings, as the member screens do; every change is written to the account log. Needs the
            Trade permission.

get.summary: The account's symbols (pairs), each with its BUY and SELL books and settings.
One symbol (pair) of the account.

patch.summary:
Change one symbol's settings (SYMSTG, the DCA gates, ExternalRef), as the member screens do. Needs the Trade
            permission.

get.summary: Settled orders (closed, cancelled, expired, refused), newest first.
One settled order.
Live orders: queued, sent to the terminal, open positions and pending orders.
HYBRID DCA proposals waiting for an answer.

post.summary:
Accept or reject a HYBRID DCA proposal. A reject adds nothing, so it is allowed while an admin has disabled the
            account's owner; an accept is an add and is not. Needs the Trade permission.

get.summary: One order: the live order, or, once it has settled, its history row (a DtoFxsOrdh).
The broker's symbols for this account and which are enabled.

put.summary:
Add and/or remove symbols from the account's enabled list (at most 64, using broker names). The server
            applies the changes to its current list, so a stale picker cannot replace a concurrent change. Needs Trade permission.

get.summary: One symbol's specification and latest quote.
The account's performance by day between two dates (UTC).
The selected account's recent performance window.
The selected account's performance bars.
The account's latest activity as the member screens show it (fills, closes, refusals, terminal events).

post.summary: Change the broker password and queue the terminal operation.

get.summary: Recent terminal operations for this account.

What changed on the accounts this key can reach, oldest first: Account (each sync and each settings change),
            Terminal, Pair, Order (queued, picked up, filled, refused, a HYBRID proposal and its answer) and History (settled, and
            close details arriving later). Each row names the record and its ids; re-read it when you need all of it. Start without
            a cursor: that returns no rows and a cursor at "now", so read the accounts once, then follow the feed. Keep the
            returned cursor and call again while `More` is true. The feed runs about ten seconds behind FinCopy's writes, so a
            write still finishing is read on a later call. `take` is 1 to 1000 (default 500).

This key's webhook, if one is set (the secret is never shown again). API key only: a webhook belongs to a key,
            so a member session cannot call it.

put.summary:
Set this key's webhook: an HTTPS address on port 443 that resolves to public addresses only. FinCopy then POSTs
            the change feed to it (event "changes": Changes, Cursor, More), at least once and oldest first, retrying with back-off
            and stopping after 20 failures in a row; a retry may repeat rows, and each row is safe to apply twice. Each POST carries X-FinCopy-Timestamp (Unix seconds) and X-FinCopy-Signature:
            "sha256=" + lowercase hex of HMAC-SHA256(secret, timestamp + "." + raw body). The secret is in this reply only. Setting
            the webhook again makes a new secret and restarts it from now. API key only, with the Trade permission.

delete.summary: Remove this key's webhook. API key only, with the Trade permission.

post.summary: Send a signed test POST (event "ping") to this key's webhook. API key only, with the Trade permission.

The facts a trade ticket needs for one symbol: price, lot limits, the side's books and settings. For a signed-in
            member session it also says whether the account owner's trade PIN must be entered (a key never needs one).

Make one FXS action (NEW, AVL, AVG, CLO, CLA, CLG, STP, CSL) on one side. A close is allowed while an admin has
            disabled the account's owner; an open or add is not. The Idempotency-Key header is required. Needs the Trade permission.
Open a BUY and a SELL on one symbol together. The Idempotency-Key header is required. Needs the Trade permission.
Change an order's TP field, SL field, expiry, or a pending order's price. Needs the Trade permission.
Cancel an order that has not yet been delivered to the terminal. Needs the Trade permission.

What applying a strategy to this account would change, per symbol, without changing anything. The strategy is
            one of the account owner's or a FinCopy preset (list them with the strategies route and this ACNO).
            Needs the Trade permission on the account.

Apply a strategy (the account owner's or a FinCopy preset) to this account: the account and its symbols take the strategy's settings, and a
            side that holds orders keeps what it must keep. The reply counts what changed and what was held. Needs the Trade
            permission on the account.

Start the account's hosted terminal. The Idempotency-Key header is required. Needs the Trade permission.
            Returns the operation id.

Stop the account's hosted terminal. The Idempotency-Key header is required. Needs the Trade permission.
            Returns the operation id.

Restart the account's hosted terminal (a terminal never set up is started). The Idempotency-Key header is
            required. Needs the Trade permission. Returns the operation id.

get.summary: Lists the pairs across accounts the caller can reach.
Lists open orders across accounts the caller can reach.
Lists settled orders across accounts the caller can reach.
Lists activity across accounts the caller can reach, newest first.

HYBRID DCA proposals waiting for an answer, across accounts the caller can reach, newest first. For a signed-in
            member session each row says whether the account owner's trade PIN must be entered to answer it.

The newest terminal operations (start, stop, restart, set-up, removal) across accounts the caller can reach,
            newest first.

Daily performance bars across accounts the caller can reach, per account and per currency book, between two
            dates (UTC). `acno` narrows it to one account; `demo` to demo (true) or real (false) accounts.

Lists the strategies the caller can apply: its own and FinCopy's presets. With `acno`, the strategies of
            that account's owner (the caller needs the Trade permission on that account).

post.summary: Creates one of the caller's own strategies. Needs the Trade permission.

get.summary: Reads one strategy by its strategy number.

patch.summary:
Changes one of the caller's own strategies; omitted fields keep their values. FinCopy's presets cannot be
            changed. Needs the Trade permission.

delete.summary: Deletes one of the caller's own strategies. FinCopy's presets cannot be deleted. Needs the Trade permission.

get.summary: Reads the signals shown for the enabled symbols across accounts the caller can reach.
Lists warning and error activity across accounts the caller can reach.

A server-sent event stream of changes on the accounts the caller can reach. Each caller holds up to eight
            streams; a ninth closes the oldest.
Searches broker servers available when adding a hosted account.

CmdApiFxsAcctPatch.description: Public API settings patch. Account identity comes from the ACNO route.

CmdApiFxsHedgeMake.description: Public paired hedge request. Account identity comes from the ACNO route.

CmdApiFxsOrdrMake.description: Public trade request. Account identity comes from the ACNO route.

CmdApiFxsPairPatch.description: Public API pair patch. Pair identity comes from the PRNO route.

CmdApiFxsPreInfo.description: Public trade preflight request. Account identity comes from the ACNO route.

CmdApiFxsStgApply.description: Apply one of the member's strategies to the account in the route (preview or apply).

CmdApiWebhookSet.description: The key's webhook: the HTTPS address (port 443 only) FinCopy POSTs to when the key's accounts change.

CmdFxsSymbolsEdit.description: Add or remove symbols from the account's enabled list.

RequestId.description: The API's Idempotency-Key, set by the /v1 make route only.

CmdTermAccountExternalRef.description: The managing system's own id for a hosted account; empty clears it.

DtoApiChange.description:
One record FinCopy wrote. `Entity` is Account, Terminal, Pair, Order or History; the ids say which record to
            re-read. Order and History rows carry the order's state; Account rows the money; Terminal rows the terminal's state.

DtoApiChangeFeed.description: One page of the change feed: oldest first, the cursor to keep, and whether more rows wait.

ParkedAt.description: Set when FinCopy stopped sending after 20 failures in a row. Set the webhook again to resume.

DtoApiWebhook.description: The key's webhook. `Secret` is shown once, when the webhook is set: FinCopy signs every POST with it.

DtoApiWebhookPing.description: A webhook test: whether the receiver answered 2xx, and its HTTP status.

DtoDemoAvailability.description:
Demo places that can start now (a prepared terminal and a free slot), and whether this member already
            runs one (one at a time).

DtoEAAccStg.description: Wire twin of the account settings. This type deliberately has no BSON attributes.

DtoEASymStg.description: Wire twin of pair settings. This type deliberately has no BSON attributes.

AccountName.description: The name on the MT4/MT5 account, as the EA reports it; null until the first sync.

ACNO.description: The trading record's number (FxsAcct.ACNO); the Trade window's Pre-info and Make name the account by it.

Virtual.description: Whether the account's broker server is a demo server.

EnabledSymbols.description: Symbols the operator or member enabled for this account (quotes stream every sync).

AllSymbols.description: Every symbol the broker offers, as the terminal last reported it.

TradePinRequired.description: The account owner's PIN is required to answer this DCA proposal.
The account owner's PIN is required to answer this DCA proposal.

DtoFxsPair.description: Wire DTO for a trading pair; it intentionally has no BSON attributes or extra-elements bag.

OrderType.description: The MetaTrader order type (OP_BUY, OP_SELLLIMIT …); a pending order's kind.

DtoFxsStgSymStg.description: Wire twin of the account symbol template. This type deliberately has no BSON attributes.

EnabledSymbols.description: Symbols enabled for this account (quotes stream every sync).

AllSymbols.description: Every symbol the broker offers, as the terminal last reported it.

OperationId.description: The queued terminal operation; null when nothing needed doing.

At.description: When FinGraph last wrote this reading.

DtoShelfSignal.description:
FinGraph's current FXS reading for one symbol on the member's accounts. The codes are FinGraph's
            (Signal VSS … VSB, Trend VSD … VSU, Confidence None … VHigh), sent as their names.

DtoShelfSignals.description: The Signals card: the readings, strongest first, and the member's symbols with no fresh reading.

FxsCloseReason.description: Why a leg closed, as the EA reports it (`CRSN`).

ApiKey.description: A personal API key, "fck_…", from the member area. Read keys can list and view; Trade keys can also trade.
ApiKey.name: X-Api-Key

MemberSession.description: The first-party member session cookie. Use from the signed-in browser client.
MemberSession.name: fincopy_member
